data.name: Reed
data.long_meaning: The name Reed comes from the English word for the tall, slender plant of the same name. In the Bible, the Reed is used as a symbol of strength and courage. The reed was used in ancient times as a measuring rod, and it bends but does not break. This shows the resilience and flexibility of the Reed, which is a valuable trait in any Christian.

in_greek.name: Ρηδ

in_latin.name: Reed
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Reed' derivatur a latino 'harundo' vel 'canna', quod significat cannam vel virgultum. In ecclesia christiana primitiva, harundo saepe significabat fragilitatem vel temporalitatem.
